material_finding: The global public trade tape is active, but the nominal V6 discovered universe has zero recent overlap with it. Tape-dependent zero-fill observations from that universe are not economic fillability evidence.
interpretation: The Data API is not globally silent: the bounded global probe observed 16 rows inside the recent causal window.
The selected 220-condition execution universe had zero recent matches in that global activity sample.
Unwindowed per-condition queries return historical rows for sampled conditions, so the zero recent overlap is not explained by nonexistent condition identifiers.
Therefore the current zero Graph completion and zero maker fill counts cannot be used as fill-probability estimates for LF/Graph execution while the selected universe has no recent-flow overlap.
This does not prove that the selected markets can never trade; it proves that recent causal public flow is absent from the measured selection window.
successor_contract: Keep global tape health and selected-universe active-flow coverage as separate diagnostics.

Before tape-dependent Graph/RV or Local-Factor reservations, require candidate legs to belong to a universe with recent causal public-flow evidence, or fail closed when the required evidence is absent.
Use recent-flow conditions as an execution-eligibility layer, not as alpha and not as a standalone fair-value feature.
Do not infer fill probabilities from zero overlap; classify it as active-universe mismatch and collect forward evidence after selection is repaired.
For Graph/RV, retain strong event identity and then require queue-aware per-leg/joint completion plus partial-fill abort/unwind economics.
For Local Factor, retain the full statistical repair chain before any z/FDR/common-sample aggression; flow eligibility is an execution layer after valid signal construction.

Compare nominal-liquidity discovery versus active-flow-eligible discovery on the same chronological snapshots using candidate count, capital-hours, queue burden, completion states, abort/unwind loss and fill-conditioned net PnL.
Preserve the authorized paper envelope and hard safety limits; no authenticated or real-money execution.
